features.title: Engineer buildables & Barbed Wire

current.summary: Level 1 construction remains free of Supplies; upgrades still cost Supplies. Barbed Wire is now three per Engineer, capped at 50 per side.

features.change: The announced Barbed Wire increase is now released.

history.summary: Free basic construction and revised placement limits released.
Barbed Wire limits revised following feedback.
The announced Barbed Wire increase is now released.

current.summary: Level 1 construction costs no Supplies; upgrades still do. Barbed Wire: two per Engineer, with no team cap in 1.6.

previous.change: Barbed Wire: three per Engineer and 50 per side are planned.

features.title: Unit composition & Medics

current.summary: Units have two Medic slots and two Rifleman slots, replacing one and three respectively.

features.change: Further Medic and role improvements are being explored.

history.summary: Unit slot allocation changed.
Additional role changes remain exploratory.

features.title: Server Browser sorting & filters

current.summary: Fuller servers are prioritised; filters persist between sessions and Favourites target the correct server.

features.change: The developer confirms the browser changes are live.

history.summary: Browser ordering, persistent filters and Favourites corrections shipped.
Developer follow-up confirms the released behavior.

features.title: Favourites capacity

current.summary: Favourites saving was corrected in 1.6. These sources do not specify the current numerical limit.

features.change: A higher Favourites limit is under technical review.

history.summary: A capacity increase is conditional on technical feasibility.

features.title: Transport boat engine shutdown

current.summary: Manual driver exit switches the engine off. Driver death in the seat leaves it running, which prevents transport-boat spawning until it is switched off.

features.change: The manual driver exit rule is released, preserving driver-kill counterplay.

history.summary: Exit-triggered and idle-time shutdown approaches were discussed.
Feedback narrowed the plan to manual exit rather than driver death.
The manual driver exit rule is released, preserving driver-kill counterplay.

current.summary: An engine left running prevents transport-boat spawning.

previous.change: The revised plan shuts the engine off on manual driver exit, preserving driver-kill counterplay.
previous.target: Patch 1.7 if feasible; otherwise a later update

current.summary: Developers describe limited chat length and limited conversation scrollback.

features.change: Chat size, positioning and history navigation are being investigated together; a higher character limit alone would not address usability.

features.title: M1A1 Thompson

current.summary: US access: Commander, Tank Commander, Crewman, Mortar Observer, Sniper, Squad Leader, Medic, Specialist, Grenadier and Engineer.

features.change: Adds a US submachine-gun option to the listed roles.

history.summary: Adds a US submachine-gun option to the listed roles.

features.title: M16A1 30-round magazines

current.summary: Optional 30-round configuration: six magazines by default, up to ten via Barracks. The weapon gains one Weight; each magazine costs two Weight versus one for a 20-round magazine.

features.change: Adds capacity with a loadout-weight trade-off; the 20-round option remains.

history.summary: Adds capacity with a loadout-weight trade-off; the 20-round option remains.

features.title: Tank shell unloading

current.summary: Selecting another shell type unloads the chambered round and automatically loads the chosen type.

features.change: A tank crew no longer has to fire its loaded round just to switch shell types.

history.summary: A tank crew no longer has to fire its loaded round just to switch shell types.

features.title: Boat handling, speed & Fuel balance

current.summary: Both factions gain handling and top-speed improvements. The US PBR has a larger speed/acceleration advantage; the supply-carrying NVA boat now costs 250 Fuel, up from 200.

features.change: Boat handling and resource costs are rebalanced.

history.summary: Boat handling and resource costs are rebalanced.

features.title: AMD FSR Frame Generation

current.summary: Available in Video Settings on supported AMD GPUs, specified as 5000 series and newer. The publisher recommends a base rate around 60 FPS or higher to limit added latency.

features.change: Adds AMD frame generation; it is separate from NVIDIA DLSS persistence reports.

history.summary: Adds AMD frame generation; it is separate from NVIDIA DLSS persistence reports.

features.title: Redeploy punishment timer

current.summary: Choosing Redeploy no longer adds a ten-second punishment; the normal deployment timer still applies.

features.change: Removes the extra redeploy penalty, not all waiting time.

history.summary: Removes the extra redeploy penalty, not all waiting time.

features.title: Commander ability team-kill punishment

current.summary: Friendly deaths from Commander abilities such as Napalm, Artillery Strikes and Bombing Runs no longer add a team-kill punishment to the Commander.

features.change: Personal weapons and other direct actions keep their normal punishment behavior.

history.summary: Personal weapons and other direct actions keep their normal punishment behavior.

features.title: Official Server AFK timer

current.summary: Official Servers now remove inactive players after ten minutes instead of thirty.

features.change: The published change is scoped to Official Servers; no universal community-server setting is inferred.

history.summary: The published change is scoped to Official Servers; no universal community-server setting is inferred.

features.title: Faster Barracks navigation & unsaved-options warning

current.summary: Lengthy Barracks entry/exit camera transitions are removed. Leaving front-end Options with unsaved edits now prompts the player.

features.change: Improves menu flow without establishing that every saved setting persists through restart.

history.summary: Improves menu flow without establishing that every saved setting persists through restart.

features.title: NATO phonetic Unit names

current.summary: Units use NATO phonetic names, including Alfa, Bravo and Charlie.

features.change: Updates Unit naming; this does not add Clan Tags or rank emblems.

history.summary: Updates Unit naming; this does not add Clan Tags or rank emblems.

features.title: Vehicle impact kill threshold

current.summary: Vehicles must reach a higher speed before an impact kills infantry; the notes give no numerical threshold.

features.change: Raises the threshold again to reduce slow-vehicle deaths.

history.summary: Raises the threshold again to reduce slow-vehicle deaths.
